৪৫তম বিসিএস বিষয়ভিত্তিক প্রস্তুতি(৭৫ দিন.question: ৬২) 'Puffs, powders, patches, Bibles, billet-doux' is an example of_________

• The repetition of a consonant at the beginning of two or more words or stressed syllables is called Alleteration. Examples-
- 'Puffs, powders, patches, Bibles, billet-doux' is an example of Alleteration. Here 'p' has been repeated thrice and 'b' twice.
- 'The fair breeze blew, the white foam flew,
The furrow followed free.' Here 'f' and 'b' have been repeated.
